svg.text: Uncertainty-aware, motion-attributed neural-SDF SLAM for deformable endoscopy (extends DDS-SLAM / Co-SLAM)
σ² weights the losses (NLL) and down-weights rays in the tracking pose solve
Co-SLAM (joint encoding · SDF/colour decoders · volume rendering · bundle adjustment)
DDS-SLAM (4D deformation field · semantic decoder + distance-field loss)
BDDS-SLAM — ours (UncertaintyNet σ² · C′ motion gate · freeze_ba · corrected BA pose step)
